title: Version 17.12.3
body_markdown:
*Released December 3rd, 2024*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| NuGet errors after upgrading from VS v17.11.6 to v17.12 with .NET 9. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/NuGet-errors-after-upgrading-from-VS-v17/10791809) |
| Private Unity messages incorrectly marked as unused IDE0051. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Private-Unity-messages-incorrectly-marke/10779025) |
| Intellisense stopped working in Word C++ project. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Intellisense-stopped-working-in-Word-C/10757161) |
| Fixed an issue where characters might be duplicated when typing in a file containing an embedded language. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Github-Copilot-with-razor-pages-duplica/10778769) |
| Fixed an issue in which resolving merge conflicts in .razor files and .cshtml files would result in an empty window. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Merge-editor-opens-a-blank-window/10786005) |
| Azure Devops Permalink from Visual Studio 2022 doesn't work. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Azure-Devops-Permalink-from-Visual-Studi/10787363) |
| Fixed an issue where Visual Studio would crash if the environment variable DOTNET\_SYSTEM\_GLOBALIZATION\_INVARIANT was set to 1. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-is-crashing-with-NET/10792667) |
| Fixed performance profiler start up error for C++ projects. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS2022-Performance-profiler-Unexpected-/10795500) |
